summary: Re-verification of the MoMo payer-vs-merchant safety guard after the _normalize_msisdn fix. **ALL TESTS PASS.** Backend: 20/20 pytest tests pass (expanded from the previous 14 to also cover the 2 new formats required by the review — `798875272` bare 9-digit, `+2500798875272` country-code + accidental leading zero — for both merchant-reject and customer-accept paths, plus VOD parity). The previously-failing 10-digit local format `0798875272` is now correctly normalized to `250798875272` and rejected with HTTP 400 + `You entered our collection account…` on both `/api/billing/momo/initiate` and `/api/billing/vod/{id}/momo`. Customer number `+250 794 230 137` (and its local + bare 9-digit variants) all pass the guard and reach BeSoft (which may fail downstream — that's expected and out of scope). MongoDB verification: every new payment doc created with a customer number persists `phone=250794230137` (normalized) and merchant MSISDN `250798875272` never appears as a debit phone for new docs. Frontend: all 3 checkout re-verification cases pass — MoMo phone input renders blank `+250 ` on load, entering `0798875272` shows the `checkout-error` banner with the exact 'You entered our collection account. Please enter YOUR own Mobile Money number to pay.' message, and entering `+250 794 230 137` passes the guard (shows 'MTN MoMo temporarily unavailable' downstream banner, which is expected). Direction audit still confirms `debit.payer_identifier=payer` and `credits[0].payee_identifier=BESOFT_PAYOUT_MSISDN` are never swapped, and the guard is invoked in both endpoints. Safety bug from iteration_12 is FIXED.

Note: BeSoft downstream is currently returning 'MTN MoMo temporarily unavailable' for all live requests — do NOT count that as a guard failure; it is expected per the review and confirmed by the presence of the Stripe fallback banner.
rca_of_issue: Previous iteration_12 root cause was `_normalize_msisdn` only handled 9-digit local numbers. This iteration verifies the applied fix (add `if len(digits) == 10 and digits.startswith('0'): return '250' + digits[1:]` plus `if len(digits) == 13 and digits.startswith('2500'): return '250' + digits[4:]`) via 7 merchant formats × 2 endpoints (14 guard-reject tests) + 3 customer formats (3 accept tests) + auth + source-audit + VOD accept = 20 tests total, all passing. Frontend UI banner confirmed via testID=checkout-error.
